verdict.pick: BenQ e-Reading LED Swing Arm Desk Lamp
verdict.line: Picture a long night of coding or reading: the BenQ e‑Reading gives you a wide, adjustable light that reduces eye strain and keeps you focused. It wins because it offers the most adjustable swing arm and consistent illumination among the picks. The catch: it is the most expensive.
